description: This Java source file defines the RepeatingAlarmFragment class, which extends Fragment and manages setting up a repeating alarm using AlarmManager. It handles user interaction to trigger the alarm setup, creates intents, and configures alarm parameters.

classes.name: RepeatingAlarmFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that sets up a repeating alarm when a menu item is selected, using AlarmManager and PendingIntent to trigger MainActivity at regular intervals.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and indicates it has options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection to set up and start a repeating alarm that triggers MainActivity every 15 seconds.
